items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle, the world's largest lithium producer, has suffered as lithium prices have tanked ~80% from late 2022 highs. Downward earnings revisions earn the stock a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: the call: Thursday 8 October | head to head
items.snippet: Albemarle is highly leveraged to the lithium price; management EBITDA scenarios: ~$1B at $10, $2.5B at $20, $4B at $30.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year but well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating as the firm lowers lithium company targets following recent spot price weakness, while continuing to view the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in EVs and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its 2026 outlook, expecting the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: The demand for lithium carbonate is expected to continue its growth trend, with potential for price increases.
items.snippet: Albemarle's Chilean capacity has been affected by strikes; SQM lithium sales may continue to grow in H2; Argentine projects ramping ahead of schedule.
